meta.priceDisclaimer: All HKD values are estimates (sealed retail anchors, MSRP-derived, or unknown ranges). Never treat as verified live listings. Meta shifts.
meta.viabilityNote: Tiers mapped from BEYWATCH.GG: beywatch X→S, S→A, A→B, B→C, C→D, sparse/?→Unranked. usagePct = BEYWATCH pickRate × 100.
meta.usageSource: BEYWATCH.GG pickRate (share of reported top-three results that included the part)
meta.cxNote: CX Custom Line = Lock Chip + Main Blade + Assist Blade (+ optional Over Blade not required in builder). Score uses stacked part bases; metal Lock + Heavy Assist get mass bonuses.
meta.ratchetIntegratedNote: Blades with ratchetIntegrated:true cannot equip a separate ratchet (Expand Blade / Infinity).

blades.name: Shark Scale

cons: High recoil / KO risk when hit squarely
